Check an Atlantis initial-conditions file

Source: R/check.R
check_init.Rd

Lists the values of an initial-conditions file that Atlantis will read wrongly, or that are likely mistakes. Only the cells Atlantis uses are checked: the water layers of each box (numlayers) and the sediment layers, for the tracers that exist there (attributes inwc and insed; both cell types when neither is set, as for vertebrates).

Usage

check_init(path, groups = NULL, ratio = 100)

Arguments

path

Path to the initial-conditions netCDF file.

groups

The functional groups: a data frame with columns Code, Name, IsTurnedOn, NumCohorts and GroupType (e.g. the group property of an Atlantis object) or the path to the groups CSV file. If NULL, the checks that need the groups are skipped.

ratio

Fold difference with the sister groups above which a pool is reported.

Value

An atlantis_check data frame, one row per finding, with columns file, check, severity ("error", "warning" or "note"), key (the variable) and message.

Details

The checks (column check of the result) are:

  • "invalid" (error): NaN or infinite values;

  • "negative" (error): negative values;

  • "unset" (warning): cells left unset (read as NA) in a variable whose _FillValue is not 0, so that Atlantis silently uses the fill value there (e.g. 2000 mg N m-3 of refractory detritus), unless every value set equals the fill value;

  • "missing" (error): a group switched on in the groups file with no variable in the file;

  • "zero": a group switched on but with no biomass or no individual anywhere (warning), or an age class with individuals but a StructN or ResN of 0 (error);

  • "sisters" (warning): a biomass pool whose typical value (median of its non-zero cells) is more than ratio times larger or smaller than the median of the groups of the same type (GroupType, the detritus types together) and units, or than the other group if there are only two.

The last three need groups. Values unset are taken as Atlantis takes them, i.e. equal to their fill value.

See also

check_prm() for the parameter files, set_init_values() to change values.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
check_init("LakeErieInit_NP.nc", "LakeErieGroupsDem.csv")
} # }
